about: Benchmark briefs used to check that the studio generalizes across management genres. Run them from the Benchmarks page (quick builds) — they are not generated during installation.

briefs.name: Airline CEO
briefs.prompt: Build me a deep airline management game where I start with a small regional airline and can eventually build a global carrier. I want realistic aircraft economics, routes, hubs, labor, airport negotiations, customer segmentation, alliances, acquisitions, recessions, fuel prices, regulators, competitors, history, commissioner mode, and a very polished visual interface. Make it deep but not overwhelming.

briefs.name: Sports Agent
briefs.prompt: Make a sports agent career game. I sign athletes, negotiate their contracts and endorsements, manage their careers and reputations, and compete with rival agencies for the best clients. Contract negotiations should be deep and realistic. Include a commissioner mode and history.

briefs.name: Restaurant Group
briefs.prompt: I want a restaurant group tycoon game. Start with one restaurant, hire chefs, design menus and concepts, deal with critics and inspections, and expand into a restaurant empire across cities. Deep but easy to understand.

briefs.name: Venture Capital
briefs.prompt: Create a venture capital firm simulator. I raise funds from LPs, source and evaluate startups, negotiate term sheets, sit on boards, follow on or write off investments, and build a track record. Include market cycles and an anti-portfolio.

briefs.name: Broadway Producer
briefs.prompt: Build a Broadway producer game. I option rights, hire creative teams and stars, raise capital from investors, book theaters, run previews and openings, handle critics, and manage long runs and tours. It should feel like the real business of theater.

briefs.name: Theme Park Company
briefs.prompt: Theme park company tycoon: build and run parks, add rides and attractions, price tickets and passes, manage crowds and safety, compete with rival parks, and expand into a global entertainment company.

briefs.name: Private Equity
briefs.prompt: Make a private equity game. I raise funds, buy companies with leverage, install management, run operational improvements, refinance, and exit through sales or IPOs. Credit cycles and interest rates should matter a lot.

briefs.name: University Athletic Director
briefs.prompt: I want to be a university athletic director. Hire and fire coaches, manage budgets across sports, build facilities, negotiate media and conference deals, deal with boosters, compliance and the university president, and build a winning, financially healthy program.
